class: an anchor left as the placeholder

expect.why: `=?` is what an author writes while choosing the ground and what `sha --write` replaces with the digest of the section as the tree has it; left as written it names no datum, so nothing downstream could compare it against anything, and it is refused before any artifact is read

note: a flat seed, like D56: the anchor names no revision, so no checker has any reason to reach for git here
